source_policy.fallback_rule: GitHub/yfinance, FinMind and TAIFEX may fill null fields only when the observation belongs to the same specified trade date/session date. Never silently overwrite a non-null canonical value or use a different trade date.
source_policy.trade_date_rule: Latest completed U.S. cash session is 2026-09-01. Taiwan cash/FX/OI latest completed session is 2026-09-01. TAIFEX after-hours physical window 2026-09-01 15:00–2026-09-02 05:00 is attributed to session_trade_date 2026-09-02.
source_policy.uncertainty_rule: When exact same-session data are not independently verified, retain null and flag validation_required. Different-date observations must never be blended.

breaking_news.headline: WTI surges above $90 as U.S.-Iran fighting renews Hormuz supply risk
breaking_news.summary: U.S. crude settled at $90.22, up $4.46 or 5.2%, as renewed fighting revived fears of disruption around the Strait of Hormuz.
breaking_news.market_impact: Oil shock reinforces inflation risk, keeps Treasury yields elevated and pressures equity valuation multiples.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Negative for energy-intensive and high-duration growth names; potentially supportive for selected shipping/energy themes.

breaking_news.headline: Dell beats sharply as AI-server revenue and backlog surge
breaking_news.summary: Dell reported Q2 revenue about $46.97B and adjusted EPS $7.04; AI-optimized server revenue reached $16.4B and AI backlog $95B. Full-year revenue outlook was raised to about $192B.
breaking_news.market_impact: Strong evidence that enterprise AI infrastructure demand remains robust despite macro-rate pressure.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Constructive read-through for Taiwan ODM, AI server, networking, PCB, cooling, power and advanced-packaging supply chains.

breaking_news.headline: Palo Alto Networks tops expectations on AI-security demand
breaking_news.summary: Palo Alto reported adjusted EPS about $1.02 versus $0.98 expected and revenue about $3.41B, up roughly 34% year on year.
breaking_news.market_impact: Shows AI-related spending is broadening from compute hardware into enterprise security/software.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Indirectly supportive for datacenter investment, while hardware read-through depends on capex conversion.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. July job openings rise modestly while hiring remains soft
breaking_news.summary: BLS JOLTS showed 7.271M job openings in July, up from revised 7.182M, while hires were around 5.054M.
breaking_news.market_impact: Mixed labor picture keeps Friday payrolls central to the Fed path as inflation and oil pressures rise.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Rate expectations remain a key valuation driver for Taiwan technology shares.

breaking_news.headline: ISM manufacturing remains in expansion but cools from July
breaking_news.summary: August ISM manufacturing PMI was 54.6 versus 55.6 in July and below roughly 55.2 consensus; input-price pressure remained a concern.
breaking_news.market_impact: Growth is still positive but not strong enough to offset inflation worries from energy and rates.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Keeps focus on selective AI/capex demand rather than a broad cyclical reacceleration thesis.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Dell's AI server revenue doubles and backlog reaches $95B
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Dell Q2 AI-optimized server revenue reached $16.4B, with $95B AI backlog and a major full-year revenue outlook increase.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Confirms continued demand for GPU/accelerator systems, high-speed networking and rack-scale infrastructure.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Strong read-through for ODM, foundry/packaging, PCB, cooling, power and networking suppliers.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Taiwan emphasizes reliability and global collaboration at SEMICON
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Taiwan highlighted rule of law and international cooperation as strategic advantages while TSMC continues major U.S. and European expansion.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Reinforces the strategic role of Taiwan capacity in global semiconductor supply chains.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Constructive structurally for TSMC and equipment/materials ecosystems, while geopolitical and tariff risk remain.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AI power and datacenter financing scrutiny rises alongside record buildout
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Texas froze new grid-connection requests while examining potentially duplicated/speculative datacenter demand; separately SB Energy filed for a U.S. IPO after major AI-related financing and Nvidia investment.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: AI capex remains strong, but power availability, financing quality and duplicate demand are emerging constraints.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Positive volume signal for hardware, but favors suppliers tied to funded/energized projects rather than speculative capacity requests.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Apple outperforms in a broad risk-off session
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Apple closed $325.13, up 2.61%, while major indexes and most semiconductor names fell.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Shows Mag-7 dispersion remains high and capital is not exiting large-cap technology uniformly.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Apple supply-chain read-through should be judged on device/order data rather than semiconductor beta alone.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Microsoft slips as higher yields weigh on mega-cap duration
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Microsoft fell 1.24% to $501.02 despite continued strong Azure/AI monetization expectations.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Rate sensitivity is offsetting some fundamental AI optimism in software megacaps.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Datacenter hardware impact remains tied to Microsoft capex and deployment, not the stock's one-day move.

weekly_calendar.consensus_context: Public previews cluster around +50K to +65K payroll growth and roughly 4.2% unemployment; validate immediately before release.

narration_points: Oil shock returns: WTI settled above $90, up 5.2%, as renewed U.S.-Iran fighting revived Hormuz supply risk.
Rates remain the main valuation headwind: the U.S. 10-year yield reached 4.798% intraday, VIX rose to 16.09 and all four major U.S. indexes closed lower.
AI hardware demand remains strong underneath the macro selloff: Dell's AI-server revenue reached $16.4B and backlog $95B, with a large full-year outlook increase.
Semiconductor tape is selective: NVDA -1.52%, AMD -2.36% and TSM ADR -0.32%, while Apple gained 2.61%.
Taiwan cash surged on Sep 1, but the after-hours session attributed to Sep 2 reversed sharply; exact official final must be filled only from the same TAIFEX session.
Today's focus shifts to ADP and the Beige Book plus Broadcom, Snowflake and HPE earnings, followed by Friday payrolls.
